name: pixelbox-monorepo
description: PixelBox 像素盒 monorepo 聚合入口(pnpm workspace:sdk / simulator / server / examples)

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @pixelbox/sdk run build && pnpm --filter @pixelbox/server run build && pnpm --filter @pixelbox/examples run build && pnpm --filter pixelbox-simulator run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @pixelbox/sdk run typecheck && pnpm --filter pixelbox-simulator run typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm run selfcheck && pnpm run check:terminal && pnpm run check:settings && pnpm run check:fullscreen
